audio_evidence.observation: Introductory section with isolated female vocals over subtle ambient synth pads and a ticking rhythmic motif.
A bouncy UK garage-inflected two-step beat enters with a syncopated kick, skittering snare, and soft electric piano chords accompanying lead vocals.
Pop chorus hook driven by stacked melodic vocals, tight sub-bass, clean electronic percussion, and pitched vocal chops.

unmapped_styles.audible_basis: Prominent UK garage 2-step rhythm pattern combined with polished girl-group pop songwriting.
